bannerNotice.body: ASSBEs are the simplified accounting framework for small business enterprises in China, providing reduced disclosure and measurement requirements compared to full ASBE. They apply to non-listed enterprises meeting specified size criteria without public accountability.
bannerNotice.title: Small Business Framework

title: Accounting Standards for Small Business Enterprises (ASSBEs) — Framework Overview
summary: ASSBEs are the simplified accounting standards for small business enterprises in China.
description: The Accounting Standards for Small Business Enterprises (ASSBEs) provide a simplified framework for small business enterprises in China, reducing the complexity of full ASBE standards while maintaining core accounting principles.
